title: Unified Communications Engineer
summary: A unified communications (UC) engineer runs a company's phone calls, voicemail and video meetings on platforms such as Cisco CUCM, Webex or Microsoft Teams Phone. You usually sit in the network or infrastructure team, connect these platforms to telecom carriers, and fix call quality problems for users.
dailyDuties: Add and change users, phones and numbers on the calling platform
Configure SIP trunks and session border controllers to carriers
Troubleshoot dropped calls and one-way audio from call traces
Resolve P1 and P2 voice tickets within SLA
Plan and test upgrades or migrations to cloud calling
Update dial plans, call flows and runbooks

skills.expectation: Build and troubleshoot SIP trunks, call flows and session border controllers
Run calling on at least one UC platform
Run calling on at least one UC platform
Fix NAT, DNS and firewall issues that break voice and video
Set up voice VLANs and QoS on switches and routers
Work P1/P2 voice incidents and changes through an ITIL ticket queue
Explain call issues and plans to users, carriers and other teams
Manage Teams and Microsoft 365 user settings
Bulk-provision users and phone numbers with PowerShell
Run UC servers on VMware ESXi
Take part in on-call for voice outages
Document dial plans and call flows

groups.label: A calling platform (Cisco CUCM/Webex or Microsoft Teams Phone)

certifications.why: Networking base that Cisco voice roles expect
